basis: todo.json win_definition: a cell wins only if (1) the point estimate is better with a paired 95% CI excluding 0 at the cell's alpha AND (2) the (quality, NFE) frontier dominates at every rung with a better plateau. TIE is not a win.
canonical_taxonomy: Canonical numbering (paper §7.2 / CLAIMS CLM-060). The earlier headline-evidence numbering and the paper-data directory names are historical aliases; see taxonomy_map.

cells.name: LineageFlow HMMER hit count
cells.protocol: N=1000 per arm, NFE=150, 3 rounds, seed 42 (single-seed); GAP-69 profile-init at seeds 42/43/44; GAP-79 dose screen at N=200, seed 42

point.caveat: Single seed. The 3-seed profile-init arm (GAP-69) fires on the aggregate (8.06-8.46x) but fails family identity: PF00072 and PF00183 sit at 0.79-0.80x of the init-only control in every seed. GAP-79 round-2 screen lifts all three target families at W0.5 (PF00072 23/50, PF00183 14/50, PF02517 5/50) with the guard unchanged at 8/50, but the N=1000 confirmation was stopped before it produced a verdict.

frontier.quote: No cell has a complete grid

cells.scope: Point win is single-seed and metric-level (hit count); the family-identity half is still open.
cells.next: GAP-79 confirmation at W0.5, N=1000, seeds 42/43/44 (stopped 2026-10-27; restart when the GPU frees).

cells.name: Kanzi reconstruction RMSD
cells.protocol: N=1000, index-matched two-sample, seed 42, byte-stable framework arm (sigma=0)

point.caveat: Small effect. The comparison is index-matched, not paired (the two arms are statistically independent, corr ~ +0.02). Reconstruction is evaluated on synthetic input coordinates, not native structures.

cells.scope: Point win measured; the frontier half has no grid.
cells.next: Run a Kanzi (quality, NFE) grid on the same checkpoint and seed policy (GAP-84 protocol).

cells.name: FlowMol3 fragment deviation
cells.protocol: N=1000 per arm, NFE=250, seeds 42/43/44, paired across seeds

point.caveat: The single-seed reading (-0.061, CI [-0.117,-0.001], p=0.043) does not survive the 3-seed test. The real restart blend moves the mean to -0.0548 but the SD grows (0.1526), so d_z stays -0.359.

cells.scope: Point estimate is direction-consistent but not significant at 3 seeds; the existing NFE ladder is a stub.
cells.next: GAP-81 sigma screen (6 cells x N=1000, seed 42), pre-registered in docs/audit/gap81-r3-sigma-dose.md.

cells.name: 2D Two Moons Wasserstein-2
cells.protocol: N=1000 per arm, 10 seeds (42-51), NFE=150, 5 rounds, restart-capable driver

point.ci95: paired t across seeds; CI includes 0
point.caveat: Measured on a real restart. The shipped restart operator is a 16x loss (1.2804 vs 0.0783); the aligned record-scoped, variance-preserving, integrate-from-memory arm is the 0.0844 reading. The old TIE was measured on a path that never restarted.

frontier.quote: No cell has a complete grid

cells.scope: TIE is a loss under the standing rule.
cells.next: A mechanism lever that moves W2 beyond the 0.01 floor; the mode lever was falsified at 0.0034.

cells.name: CIFAR-10 rectified-flow FID
cells.protocol: N=1000, seed 42, NFE=50 matched budget, single round (production checkpoint)

point.ci95: not computed at the N=1000 single-round reading
point.caveat: 2 of 4 arms improve at N=1000, versus 4 of 4 at N=200. The N=200 and N=1000 baselines are different evaluator readings and must not be pooled.

cells.scope: Point reading is arm-dependent; the frontier has two rungs and the baseline is still descending.
cells.next: GAP-71 BEFORE arm (matched NFE, N=1000, 3 seeds) then the spectral arm; extend the grid past NFE=200.

cells.name: MNIST flow-matching FID
cells.protocol: N=1000 per arm, 3 seeds, 4 checkpoints, NFE grid {4,5,10,25,50,100,200}, min 2 steps per round

point.ci95: per-rung improvement CIs exclude 0 at every rung on w16e1_5k
point.p: no p-value used for the frontier verdict
point.caveat: Checkpoint-conditional: the WIN is on w16e1_5k only (7/7 strict-gain rungs, per-rung CI lower bounds above the 1-FID floor). The other three checkpoints are TIEs, not losses. On w16e1_10k the plateau gain is 1.0036 FID as a point estimate but its 95% CI lower bound is 0.984 FID, and no rung's CI lower bound clears the floor.

cells.scope: w16e1_5k checkpoint only; the other three checkpoints are TIEs. This is the only cell with the frontier half measured.
cells.next: None required for the 5k WIN. The 10k cell clears the 1-FID floor as a point estimate (1.0036) but not at its CI lower bound (0.984); that is a checkpoint property, not a lever.

cells.name: LineageFlow k6 foldability
cells.protocol: N=1000 per seed, 3 seeds (n=3000 pooled), live tier-aware scheduler

point.effect: scPerplexity pooled d_z=-0.8393 (diff -3.6823); hard-tier pLDDT d_z=+1.1211 (n=990); pooled pLDDT d_z=+0.1466 (diff +2.6386)
point.ci95: per-seed and pooled; sign consistent on 3/3 seeds and all three tiers for scPerplexity
point.caveat: The pooled pLDDT does not reach the +0.2235 bar; the large pLDDT effect is hard-tier only. The scPerplexity axis is the uniform win.

cells.scope: Point win on scPerplexity and hard-tier pLDDT; the frontier half has no usable grid.
cells.next: Build a k6 (quality, NFE) grid on the same checkpoint and seed policy.

point.ci95: not computed across seeds in the artifact
point.caveat: Large effect but n=3 seeds cannot clear alpha. A per-record test is impossible from the stored artifacts: only the aggregate and smiles_list[:200] were persisted, and no per-molecule PoseBusters verdict exists.

cells.name: LineageFlow Pfam novelty
cells.protocol: N=1000 per arm, mmseqs against the canonical 63.8M Pfam-A database, seed 42

point.effect: baseline 466/1000 (46.6%) vs framework 37/1000 (3.7%) novel; 12.6x less novel
point.caveat: Direction inverted relative to the original claim. The novelty collapse is already in the scalar control, so it belongs to the restart operator, not to the mask.

cells.scope: Measured loss; the lever (what the restart draws) is pre-registered but not run.
cells.next: GAP-70 round 2: tempered fresh draw, lambda in {0,0.1,0.2,0.35,0.5,0.75,1}, N=1000, seed 42, NFE=10 (7 cells).

summary.note: One cell (R5c, w16e1_5k) satisfies both halves of the win definition. Seven cells have a point reading but no frontier grid; that is the single largest gap between the evidence base and the paper's claim.
summary.paper_label_note: Paper-facing label used in §7.1/§7.2/§7.11. It is distinct from cell_verdict: cell_verdict is the strict two-half WIN gate (point WIN and frontier WIN); paper_label also admits CONDITIONAL, TIE and SUPP.
